text:
liam: Quick release-train broadcast for this sprint. Short version: tightening pre-canary checks, moving canary window, and new one-line canary status. Please ack.

liam: Canary window for this train: Thu 04:00-08:00 UTC. Freeze unchanged: Sat 00:00 - Mon 06:00 UTC.

liam: Required checklist before flipping any canary:
- run `ci/release-smoke` (or `make smoke`)
- confirm P95 <= baseline * 1.10
- sustained error rate < 1% over 5m post-flip
- add label `release:gated` to PRs that must follow canary path

yasmin: Ack. Where are baseline numbers?

liam: Baselines on internal dash: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/release-baselines (eng-release).

omar: We have an embedding change scheduled. Will heavy-token services need longer canaries?

liam: Yes — heavy-token services get extended canary by default. Tag `release:extended-canary` and coordinate with eng-sre.

ops-bot: CI updated for train-1789: added `check:perf-smoke` and `check:dedicated-route` to smoke pipeline. :gear: 

release-bot: Policy note: reverting gating rules requires documented approval from release leads and eng-sre. See /policies/release-gates.

yasmin: Please post a one-line canary flip status so oncall can scan quickly.

liam: Agreed. Canary flip one-liner format: `canary=<id> | model=<name> | state=up|down | t=MMm | p95=XXXms | err=Y%`. One line copy-paste please.

omar: Opt-out for emergency patches?

ops-bot: Emergency opt-out: `/optout release-gates --reason "emergency" --owner @you` plus ops approval in-thread within 30m. All opt-outs are audit logged.

liam: Action items:
- eng owners: run smoke + tag PRs
- eng-sre: monitor P95 & error-rate during Thu window
- release leads: approve exceptions in-thread with mitigation

yasmin: Acked. I'll move non-critical migrations out of the freeze window.

omar: Pushed tokenizer fix, running smoke now (PR #5230).

liam: Thanks. I'll post a short changelog tomorrow with final canary outcomes and any rollbacks. Ping @liam or escalate in #eng-oncall if blocked.
